text:

{本番|ほんばん}　{行|い}っちまうか？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_03_dragonbb_03

label: sdc02_4kings_d_03_dragonbb_04

label: sdc02_4kings_d_03_dragonbb_05
